title: fix(plugin-auth): a credential-scope posture does not hold an impersonation session (#24762)
body:
Fixes #24762

Clause-②: no

An administrator who impersonated a user who must change their password (the default of Create User, Set Password and Import) was stranded: the impersonation session was refused `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` on every protected route, and the console showed the target's change-password screen. This PR executes B1 of the ruling, items 1 to 5. Item 6 (C, the console's "Stop impersonating" exit) is objectstack-ai/objectui#13208, a separate card that stays open and is related only.

## The ruling this executes

Ruling `6288774214` (`batch #376` item 1, letter E, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-20T10:23Z), quoted:

> 1. **The rule.** A `credential`-scope posture (`PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`, `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`) does not hold an impersonation session. An `account`-scope posture (`MFA_REQUIRED`, and any future account-standing posture) still does. Why: the impersonation session is minted from the administrator's own session, which has passed its own posture check. It is not the target's password sign-in, and the password sign-in is the only thing a `credential` posture holds, per the declaration.
> 2. **Where: once, at the producer.** In `plugin-auth`'s `customSession`, when `session.impersonatedBy` is set, filter the postures `resolveUserAuthGates` reports to those whose `AUTH_GATE_SCOPES[code]` is `account`, then take the first that remains. ⛔ Do not drop `gates[0]`: a target held by both `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` and `MFA_REQUIRED` answers `MFA_REQUIRED`. No seam, door or client restates the rule.

`Governing text:` ADR-0069 D3 and its amended note (ruling C′ on #23287, 6159450584); the ADR-0069 status block; `AUTH_GATE_SCOPES` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` (read, not edited).

## What changed

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`
  - `customSession` reads `session.impersonatedBy` (the print door's reading: a non-blank string) and passes `{ impersonation: true }` to `computeAuthGate`.
  - `computeAuthGate` takes an optional `options` argument. With `impersonation: true` it answers `accountScopeAuthGate(gates)`, the first `account`-scope posture wherever it sits in the list. That is `@objectstack/core`'s existing reader over `AUTH_GATE_SCOPES`, the one the API-key admission seam already uses, so no second list exists. Without the option it answers `gates[0]`, byte for byte as before.
  - The docblock premise "Every scope holds a session, because a session IS the password sign-in" is corrected to name the impersonation session (ruling item 4). The `resolveUserAuthGates` docblock's two sentences about what the session shows are corrected with it.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`: the `mustChangePassword` passage gains the impersonation sentence, and says that enforced MFA still holds an impersonation session.
- `.changeset/24762-impersonation-credential-posture.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, `Clause-②: no`.
- Pins, below. No ADR, no spec edit, no new error code and no new gate (ruling item 5).

### How the impersonation fact reaches `computeAuthGate` (the choice the ruling left open)

Measured first (H3): on a real boot, `GET /auth/get-session` with the impersonation session's bearer answers `session.impersonatedBy` equal to the administrator's id, and `customSession` receives the same `session` object. The pin's `impersonateTarget()` asserts this on every impersonation it uses.

- **Chosen: a parameter on `computeAuthGate`** (`options.impersonation`, default absent). The session gate keeps ONE carrier, and the rule lives in it.
- **Not chosen: a filter at the call** (`customSession` calling `resolveUserAuthGates` and filtering inline). The session posture would then be derived in two places, and `computeAuthGate` would no longer be the session gate's carrier that the doors cite.
- Four axes: business need, the same (both serve the measured verify-a-new-user path). Long-term soundness: the parameter keeps one derivation. AI error resistance: the parameter is opt-in and named, so a caller that omits it gets the old answer, and no second copy of the filter can drift. Startup scope: both are the same size; neither adds a gate.

### Other callers of `computeAuthGate`: unchanged for every session

- The impersonation door's caller check (`applyPlatformAdminImpersonation`'s `postureOf`) and the vendor-served platform-admin doors (`assertActorNotHeld`: the admin plugin's role-scalar actions and `/sso/register|update-provider|delete-provider`) pass no option. Their answer is `gates[0]`, as before, for a non-impersonation session and for an impersonation session alike.
- Evidence: the existing `computeAuthGate` unit cases (options omitted) pass unchanged, and `@objectstack/verify`'s `held-session-vendor-admin-doors.pin.test.ts` (both callers on a real boot, every held state) passes: 3 files, 49 tests, below.

## Pins (ruling item 3), each ablated

`packages/verify/src/held-session-impersonation-target.pin.test.ts`, a real boot through the data plane's seam, each refusal asserted as `403` with the posture's code nested under `error` (ADR-0112):

- (a) a `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` target's impersonation session reads `GET /data/sys_user?limit=1` 200, and its session payload carries no `authGate`. The reset is armed through the real door, `/admin/set-user-password` with its `mustChangePassword` default.
- (b) the target's own session still answers `403 PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`.
- (c) an `MFA_REQUIRED` target's impersonation session still answers `403 MFA_REQUIRED`.
- (d) a target held by both answers `403 MFA_REQUIRED` on the impersonation session.
- Controls: an unheld target reads 200 on both sessions; the MFA hold and the compound hold are proved armed on the target's own session. Ruling item 7: the forced reset's revocation (on by default) still ends the impersonation session (`revoked.sessions` at least 1, then the same bearer answers 401).

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts`, the same four cases at the producer (`customSession`'s stamped `user.authGate`), plus `PASSWORD_EXPIRED`, the other credential-scope posture.

**Ablation**, one leg removing the filter. The line `if (options.impersonation === true) return accountScopeAuthGate(gates) ?? undefined;` was replaced with a planted no-op that keeps the declaration build clean (`void ['ablation-24762-filter-removed', accountScopeAuthGate, options];`), through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor x1 to x0, blob `45d22147db17` to `3c94be9c4c2f`. The plugin-auth build answered 0. `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the plant in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`, and the filter's text absent from `dist/`.

- verify pin, mutated: **3 failed, 5 passed**. (a) red, `expected 403 to be 200`; (d) red, `expected 'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED' to be 'MFA_REQUIRED'`; the revocation control red at its first read, `expected 403 to be 200` (it reads the impersonation session before revoking). (b), (c), the unheld control and both armed-hold controls stayed green.
- plugin-auth pins, mutated: **3 failed, 1 passed**. Reset, expiry and both turned red; the MFA case stayed green.
- Restore: `ablation-replace.mjs --restore`, blob after restore equal to the HEAD blob `45d22147db17`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty. Rebuilt; the plant absent from `dist/`, the filter back in it. Re-run: verify 8 passed, plugin-auth 4 passed.
- A first leg deleted the line outright. Its JS build landed and its readings were the same, but the declaration build refused the then-unused import and parameter (TS6133), so the leg above replaced it for a clean build record. Nothing from the first leg is relied on.

## Local verification

All on `c62a583b73` (this branch's head, `origin/main` `950f949a9c` merged in), each command under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, each exit captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/verify^...' --concurrency=2`: exit 0, 48 of 48 tasks.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: exit 0, 170 files, 3264 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on `held-session-impersonation-target.pin.test.ts`, `held-session-vendor-admin-doors.pin.test.ts` and `held-session-platform-admin.pin.test.ts`: exit 0, 3 files, 49 passed. The rest of the verify suite is a declared narrowing, left to CI's Test Core.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths): 100 commands, each run. `--ran`: 100 derived, 99 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. 98 answered exit 0 on the first pass. `check:skill-examples` answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no client SDK build); after building `@objectstack/client` and `@objectstack/client-react` it answered exit 0. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, 21 packages outside this diff's build closure have no `dist/`. CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it. A direct probe: `require('packages/plugins/plugin-auth/dist/index.js')` loads (exit 0, 155 exports).

## Acceptance notes

- **Pin location.** The claim placed the pins in `plugin-auth`. No `plugin-auth` harness serves a protected route through a transport seam, and the ADR-0112 envelope is the seam's, so the route-level pins are in `@objectstack/verify`, where the real-boot held-session pins already live. The producer-level cases are in `plugin-auth`.
- **Spec text now imprecise for impersonation sessions (not edited: the ruling owes no spec edit).** `packages/spec/src/contracts/auth-service.ts`, `IAuthService.resolveUserAuthGates`, says "the session gate carries its first entry on `user.authGate`". On an impersonation session it carries the first `account`-scope entry. Suggested wording for a later spec touch: "the session gate carries its first entry on `user.authGate` (on an impersonation session, its first `account`-scope entry)". No carrier.
- **`@objectstack/core`'s `accountScopeAuthGate` docblock** names only the API-key reading; it now also serves the impersonation session. Not edited (out of the claim's file surface). No carrier.
- **The asking doors still read the target's full posture on an impersonation session.** `assertActorNotHeld` and the impersonation door's caller check ask `computeAuthGate` with the option omitted (the hard stop kept their answers unchanged). So an impersonation session of a credential-held target that reaches one of those platform-admin doors is refused `403` with the credential code, where an unheld target's impersonation session is refused by the door's own platform-admin check (also `403`). No request they refuse is admitted. Recorded as an open question in the report.
